_comment: The single source of truth for upkeep policy. Read directly by functions/upkeep-core.js (require) and compiled into public/assets/js/core/upkeep-policy.js by tools/generate_upkeep_policy.mjs, because the browser speaks ES modules and the Cloud Functions speak CommonJS. Change a number HERE and nowhere else; npm run verify fails if the generated copy drifts.
